channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Yalova attackers plotted multiple assassinations, indictment says
item.description: ISIL terrorists who killed three police officers in a clash in the northwestern province of Yalova in late 2025 had previously plotted to assassinate the provincial head of the ruling Justice and Development Party (AKP) and had also devised plans to target family members who refused to join the jihadist group, according to prosecutors.

item.title: Antalya endures a year’s rainfall in single 40-day stretch
item.description: Antalya, a major tourist and agricultural hub on Türkiye’s Mediterranean coast, has braved an extraordinary deluge in a mere 40 days, remarkably matching the city’s entire rainfall for the previous year.

item.title: Turkish salmon exports start year on a strong upswing
item.description: Turkish salmon revenues have surged by 39 percent year-on-year to reach a staggering $32.19 million in January alone, marking a powerful start to 2026 as the industry ignited the trade year with an explosive performance.

item.title: Mitsotakis: Greece–Türkiye talks proceed despite disputes
item.description: Greek Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis said Greece wants a “normal” and steady relationship with Türkiye built on open communication and respect for international law, even as major disputes between the two neighbors remain unresolved.

item.title: New rules to shield children on social media coming soon, says minister
item.description: Türkiye is close to introducing new regulations aimed at protecting children on social media platforms, Family and Social Services Minister Mahinur Özdemir Göktaş said on Feb. 15.

item.title: EU official says Türkiye key to middle corridor to China
item.description: European Union Enlargement Commissioner Marta Kos said Türkiye is a “critical partner” for regional transport and connectivity projects aimed at strengthening Europe’s access to Central Asia and China.

item.title: Türkiye deploys drillship, navy escort for Somalia offshore oil, gas search
item.description: Türkiye has dispatched the deepwater drillship “Çağrı Bey” to Somalia to begin what described as the country’s first offshore drilling mission outside Turkish waters.

item.title: Türkiye condemns Israel's land registration move in West Bank
item.description: Türkiye on Sunday strongly condemned Israel's new decision on land registration in the occupied West Bank, calling it a violation of international law.

item.title: Iran FM heads to Geneva for second round of talks with US
item.description: Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi headed to Switzerland on Sunday for the second round of renewed talks with the United States later this week, his ministry said.

item.title: Erdoğan to hold talks in Ethiopia as Türkiye steps up Africa diplomacy
item.description: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan will make a one-day visit to Ethiopia on Feb. 17, after postponing a planned trip to the United Arab Emirates (UAE), Türkiye’s Communications Directorate said.
